title: Pontotoc hosts Houston in a basketball doubleheader after Hilltoppers’ first boys loss
excerpt: The girls play at 6 p.m. Tuesday and the boys at 7:15. Houston brings two teams that beat North Pontotoc, and its boys are coming off a 57–51 overtime loss.
locality: Pontotoc High School in Pontotoc, Mississippi, and North Pontotoc High School in Ecru.

paragraphs.text: It took overtime for anyone to beat Houston’s boys this season. Pontotoc gets the next chance. On Tuesday, Dec. 1, the Hilltoppers play the Warriors at 7:15 p.m. at Pontotoc High School. The girls open the doubleheader at 6 p.m. Both Houston teams have already beaten North Pontotoc this month.

Before facing Jackson Prep, the Hilltoppers had scored at least 67 in each of their five wins, including 81 against Bayou Academy on Monday. A day later they led Jackson Prep 40–39 after three quarters. Regulation ended at 47–47, and Jackson Prep scored 10 of the 14 points in overtime to win 57–51.

Pontotoc County fans saw Houston’s girls pull away in the second half against North Pontotoc on Nov. 13. Houston led 30–20 at halftime, scored 22 points in the third and held the Vikings to two in the fourth to win 69–33. Houston’s boys won 67–34 on the same night.

The two Houston teams have different routes to Tuesday’s games. Jackson Prep was the boys’ last scheduled opponent before Pontotoc. The girls, who won their first five games, are scheduled to visit Northeast Lauderdale at 5 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 28. They then have two days between that game and their visit to the Warriors.
